# oko — BDIX Browser

> A free BDIX browser for Android: browse and stream movies, TV shows and live TV from BDIX FTP servers in Bangladesh. One app for mobile & Android TV.

oko is a free, lightweight BDIX browser built for BDIX networks in Bangladesh. It browses local FTP media servers and plays content in a clean, fast interface — no browser overhead, no account needed. Supported by ads via Google AdMob.

## Key Features
- BDIX browsing: movies, TV shows and live TV from BDIX FTP servers
- Android 5.0+ phones and Android TV in one app (package com.okoplayer.app, v1.0.0)
- Lightweight, fast, minimal interface; TV-friendly navigation
- Watch history, settings and downloads stay on-device

## Links
- Website: https://mahidsec.github.io/oko/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.okoplayer.app
- Privacy Policy: https://mahidsec.github.io/oko/privacy-policy/
- Terms of Use: https://mahidsec.github.io/oko/terms-of-use/
- Contact: officialoko@proton.me

oko connects to BDIX (Bangladesh) FTP media servers. Users must be on a supported BDIX ISP network to access content. The app browses available servers on the local network and streams in-app.
